reviewerFindings.message: Standards: CONTRIBUTING.rst documents Cassandra integration runs, but setup calls Scylla-only tuning methods unconditionally. With CASSANDRA_VERSION set and SCYLLA_VERSION unset, a fresh Cassandra node raises AttributeError before startup, preventing the regression from running. The declared [CCM Node API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scylladb/scylla-ccm/master/ccmlib/node.py) lacks both setters.
reviewerFindings.fix: Preserve startup for both server families; restrict shard and memory tuning to Scylla nodes.

reviewerFindings.message: With CASSANDRA_VERSION configured and SCYLLA_VERSION unset, use_cluster() creates Cassandra nodes. At the pinned CCM version, set_smp() and set_mem_mb_per_cpu() exist only on ScyllaNode. A fresh or stopped Cassandra node therefore raises AttributeError during module setup, preventing this regression from running.
reviewerFindings.fix: Ensure setup supports both documented server families while preserving Scylla shard and memory settings.

originalPublication.body: Review complete; no additional actionable findings. Independently confirmed the Cassandra setup failure already covered in [the existing review](https://github.com/scylladb/python-driver/pull/1134#pullrequestreview-5582561217), so no duplicate inline comment is added. Focused mocked-libev checks passed; real-extension and live-cluster tests were not run locally.

conclusions: Both configured reviewers reported the same Cassandra-only test setup defect already reported by CodeRabbit. The run independently verified it and suppressed another inline report.
The saved Code Factory profile explicitly permits a clean-review conclusion. This overrides the installed posting skill default and explains the summary-only COMMENT.
